research.title: Nonogram
research.note: Supplies the About page facts: who invented the puzzle and when, its other names, and that some puzzles need a guess while many can be solved one line at a time. The About panel also reads this article's summary live when it is opened and shows the day it was read.

inspiration.title: Picross and other nonogram games
inspiration.note: The puzzle form itself: fill a grid from the run lengths on its rows and columns. Picture Grid keeps the form, proves every picture can be finished by line logic alone, and hangs each finished picture in a gallery instead of scoring it.

inspiration.title: Flow Free
inspiration.note: The calm, untimed feel of a logic puzzle that is never lost, with hints that only come when asked.

other.title: Pyodide
other.note: Runs the game's Python rules, solver and hint ladder in the browser, so there is no server and no build step.

other.title: Hand-made pixel pictures
other.note: All 60 pictures are small grids written out by hand as data and drawn as SVG in the page. Nothing is generated by an image tool or downloaded.
